summary: This is a Docker Compose configuration file that sets up a single service called 'blog' for a Docusaurus website. It builds from the current directory, exposes port 3000, runs as a non-root user, and mounts the local blog folder into the container so changes are reflected immediately.

explanations.7: The %%port=3000%% syntax is a template placeholder that allows the port number to be substituted dynamically at runtime, then maps it to port 3000 inside the container where the application listens.
explanations.8: This runs the container as user ID 1000 and group ID 1000 instead of root, which is a security best practice to limit what the application can do if compromised.
explanations.10: This mounts the './blog' folder from your computer into the '/app/blog' folder inside the container, so any changes you make locally are immediately visible to the running application without rebuilding.
